title: How quantum computing will break all encryption by 2030

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know your data could be cracked in 5 years?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Hackers are already preparing for quantum computers to break encryption.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Quantum computing uses qubits to solve problems no classical computer can.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Shor’s algorithm can crack RSA encryption in minutes, not millennia.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Banks, governments, and your private messages will be at risk.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? We need quantum-safe encryption now.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Will you be ready when the future arrives?

caption_text: How quantum computing will break all encryption by 2030
